scope: Source documents for research-evaluation v2. Museum-authored prose is original to this repository and is not historical material. Historical passages are held-out extracts from the same public-domain works used to build the language profiles: unseen by the model, but the same work and author.
rights: Museum-authored text: MIT, with the rest of this repository. Historical passages: pre-1800 works, public domain worldwide; the extracts are short and their provenance is recorded in data/research/v2/holdout.json.

documents.text: The messenger returned before the rain. She carried a letter and a small wooden box. We read the letter together, but the name at the end was missing. The keeper asked us to compare the marks on the box with the marks in the book before making a decision.

documents.text: The old map showed a road across the valley. There were three bridges on the road and a tower beside the river. The first report said that the eastern bridge was closed. A second report arrived in the morning, so the travelers checked both accounts before leaving.
